scope: Real auth handlers over local HTTP with in-memory fault-injected AuthStore; ephemeral software fixture EIP-191 signature. No external or user wallet signature. Cookie jar is explicit and does not prove browser Secure-cookie policy.

cases.name: broadcasts invalidation metadata only, deduplicates itself, never relays received events, revokes pending work, and detaches
uses real auth HTTP handlers: failed logout preserves cookie, local veto blocks reuse, retry revokes server session, fresh login recovers
revokes a late verification before allowing a new login
does not run a queued signature for a superseded identity
revokes verification cookies when identity readback fails without provider events
